Performers
Neal O’Doan (piano), University of Washington Symphony Orchestra (orchestra), Peter Erős (conductor) Documented

Named in the Commons file description. Individual orchestral players are not identified.

[1]
Work version
Complete first movement, including the first-movement cadenza Inferred, not documented

Commons describes the file only as the 1st movement; the performing edition and revision (Grieg revised the concerto repeatedly from 1872 to 1906–⁠07) are not identified.

[1]
Recorded
Unknown Unknown

The Commons date field is “?”. The repository describes Pandora Records as a label founded in 1973 that was active for over ten years, but the file carries no session date.

[1] [2]
Place
Unknown Unknown

No venue is named. The repository describes its recordings as made in Seattle and credits Glenn White with some of them; the file itself does not say where this performance was recorded.

[1] [2]
Label
Pandora Music repository, ibiblio (Al Goldstein collection) Documented

The repository says its master tapes, and LPs where tapes were missing, were archived by the Pandora Records project.

[1] [2]
Catalogue
Unknown Unknown

No catalogue number is given.

[1]
Matrix, take, sides
Unknown Unknown

The original tape or LP carrier is not identified.

[1] [2]
Transfer
Unknown Unknown

The repository acknowledges Glenn White for making and repairing some of its recordings; no engineer is credited for this file.

[1] [2]
Transfer date
Unknown Unknown

Neither the repository file nor the Commons page gives a digitisation date.

[1]
Processing
Ogg Vorbis file hosted on Commons; MP3 access derivative generated by Commons Documented

No editing or noise processing by Contrapunctus; one complete source stream.

[1]
Composition rights
Public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms Inferred, not documented

Grieg died on 4 September 1907. This says nothing about any modern edition.

[1] [3]
Recording rights
Creative Commons Attribution-⁠ShareAlike 2.0 (the repository’s Open Audio License wording) Documented

The repository states that its files are available for free download subject to the EFF Open Audio License; Commons records this as CC BY-SA 2.0 and applies that licence to the file.
